variables.name: MIN_NORMAL
variables.comment: * A constant holding the smallest positive normal value of type * float, 2-126. It is equal to the value * returned by Float.intBitsToFloat(0x00800000).

variables.name: SIGNIFICAND_WIDTH
variables.comment:
* The number of logical bits in the significand of a
     * {@code float} number, including the implicit bit.

variables.name: MAX_EXPONENT
variables.comment: * Maximum exponent a finite float number may have. * It is equal to the value returned by * Math.ilogb(Float.MAX_VALUE).

variables.name: MIN_EXPONENT
variables.comment: * Minimum exponent a normalized float number may * have. It is equal to the value returned by * Math.ilogb(Float.MIN_NORMAL).

variables.name: MIN_SUB_EXPONENT
variables.comment:
* The exponent the smallest positive {@code float}
     * subnormal value would have if it could be normalized.

variables.name: EXP_BIAS
variables.comment: * Bias used in representing a {@code float} exponent.

variables.name: SIGN_BIT_MASK
variables.comment: * Bit mask to isolate the sign bit of a {@code float}.

variables.name: EXP_BIT_MASK
variables.comment: * Bit mask to isolate the exponent field of a {@code float}.

variables.name: SIGNIF_BIT_MASK
variables.comment: * Bit mask to isolate the significand field of a {@code float}.

variables.name: MAG_BIT_MASK
variables.comment:
* Bit mask to isolate the magnitude bits (combined exponent and
     * significand fields) of a {@code float}.
